opening.argument: The presenter solicits participation in OneCoin through a package tied to tokens, recruitment based earnings, and highly favorable return claims. He says, "I've invited 23 people to this opportunity," then describes a binary network bonus in which participants are paid on the lesser leg, while giving an example of one participant bringing another into the business. The paid access is linked to token generation because "we receive tokens with our educational package," and the presentation characterizes that structure as "a fourfold return if the coins move nowhere." He urges viewers to "seriously consider one coin" and the supplied description directs them to "Get your FREE account here now!" Taken together, these recruitment dependent benefits, paid mining access, and wealth claims promote participation through a signup pathway rather than providing neutral cryptocurrency education.
